namedPlots.coverageNote: The official wine-board list names Clos de Vougeot as one whole-cru climat. The pinned cadastre records CLOS DE VOUGEOT; historical subdivisions and producer holdings have no reviewed cadastral crosswalk and retain the whole-cru outline.

reviewedUncoveredArea.note: The measured 1084.218934 m² remainder (0.2121%) was reviewed against both pinned geometries. The largest components are narrow strips along the northern and western boundary, not a missing INAO commune. Neighbouring Flagey parcels account for 2.734058 m² of it; 1081.484876 m² is covered by no audited parcel. No geometry is added, clipped, buffered or filled. The absolute cap allows less than 0.1 m² above this reviewed measurement; changed source hashes require another review.
